title: Creating TikTok GO Content
intro: A short course from the Covenant Creative team on making TikTok GO videos that get booked: what to do at a content day, and how to turn Footage Vault clips into your own videos.

lessons.title: How TikTok GO pays you
lessons.summary: Every TikTok GO video carries a booking link. When viewers book through it, you earn a commission.
steps: Each content day lists its commission rate, shown next to the TikTok GO logo on the card.
Your main deliverable is always a TikTok GO video with the partner's booking link attached.
Views matter, but bookings pay. Show viewers exactly what they'd get if they booked.
Posts made with Footage Vault clips can carry booking links too, so you can earn without traveling.

lessons.title: Set up your Creator profile
lessons.summary: Partners look at your profile before confirming your spot. Make it easy to say yes.
steps: Add your TikTok handle and current follower count in Profile.
Pick your TikTok GO agency, or "No agency" if you're independent.
Set your home state and city so we can match you with nearby content days.
Use "I qualify" in search to see only the content days you can request.

lessons.title: Before you arrive
lessons.summary: The best content days are planned the night before.
steps: Read "What you'll do" and your 5 deliverables on the content day page.
Write a simple shot list: arrival, room reveal, amenities, food, golden hour, your hook.
Charge everything, clear phone storage, and pack a small light and a mic.
Arrive at the call time. Partners plan staff and access around it.

lessons.title: On site: what to film and how
lessons.summary: Capture the moments that make someone book, in vertical 9:16.
steps: Open with the arrival POV: walking in, check-in, the first look.
Visit different room categories and film a quick reveal of each.
Show the exclusive amenities: pools, cabanas, spa, rooftop, dining.
Get b-roll: slow pans, details, people enjoying the space (with permission).
Film golden hour last. It's usually your strongest footage.

lessons.title: Working with the partner team
lessons.summary: Be the Creator partners ask for again.
steps: Introduce yourself to your contact and confirm what's off-limits to film.
Respect guests' privacy: no faces without permission.
Thank the team on camera. It makes great content and builds the relationship.
Share raw clips if it's one of your deliverables.

lessons.title: Your 5 deliverables, explained
lessons.summary: Every content day has 5 TikTok deliverables. Here's how to nail them.
steps: The TikTok GO video with booking link is the main one. Post it first.
Stories and LIVEs are for real-time energy: post them during the day.
Photo carousels work best for room and amenity details.
Submit each post link on the content day page to earn rewards.

lessons.title: Picking the right clips
lessons.summary: Our team films partner properties so you can create without traveling.
steps: Search the Footage Vault by city, state, or partner, just like content days.
Pick 3–5 clips with a clear story: arrival, highlight, payoff.
Check the tags: drone, POV, golden hour, no music.
Save clips to "My vault clips" so they're ready when you edit.

lessons.title: Turn vault clips into your own video
lessons.summary: Vault footage plus your voice equals your video.
steps: Start with a hook in the first 2 seconds: a question, a surprise, or a price.
Add your own voiceover or on-screen text so it sounds like you.
Mix in a clip of yourself (selfie or reaction) to make it personal.
Keep it 15–30 seconds, add captions, and end with a clear call to book.

lessons.title: Footage Vault usage rules
lessons.summary: Free to use, with two simple rules.
steps: Always tag the partner in your post.
Always use the partner's TikTok GO booking link.
Don't resell or share raw vault clips outside your own TikTok posts.

lessons.title: Posting with your TikTok GO link
lessons.summary: Small details make a big difference in bookings.
steps: Add the booking link before you publish. It can't be added later.
Name the place and city in your caption and on screen.
Post when your audience is most active, then reply to comments in the first hour.

lessons.title: Submit links and earn rewards
lessons.summary: Every post you submit moves you closer to the prize.
steps: Paste your TikTok link on the content day page, the vault clip page, or Rewards.
Attending content days and submitting post links both count toward the prize.
Your best posts could be featured in the Showcase tab.
